propositions: Closing a ticket with no file impact in accepted scope unconditionally invokes full-history commit discovery before checking if that work is necessary.
When accepted ticket and descendant file impact union is empty, commit referencing discovery and resolution are discarded; the landing checks return without using those results.
An early guard based on the file impact union can skip commit discovery entirely when the union is empty, eliminating unnecessary repository scans and tracker lookups.
Tickets or descendants with declared file impact must continue to invoke commit discovery and diff enforcement to preserve landing compliance and descendant credit.
The fix preserves completion-verifier, administrative-disposition, force, and descendant-credit semantics while only short-circuiting on the empty-impact path.
